text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After the initial trial of assembling a group,
the BB Brigade's joint lesson is going smoothly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
班決めという難局を乗り越えたＢＢ団は、
グループ学習を順調に進めていた。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Ha... haha...
To think I could face the terror of a group lesson
in such a clear and refreshing state of mind...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ、
ふふ……
まさかグループ学習なんて恐ろしい授業を、
こんなにも安らかな気持ちで進められるなんて……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to the BB Brigade...!
All thanks to the encouragement you gave me, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それもこれも、
ＢＢ団のおかげ……！
{0}さんが
私の背中を押してくれたからです……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, even the legendary
\"Everyone find a partner to pair up with!\"
might be within my power to face!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この調子でいけば、
あの伝説の、
『はい、
二人一組になって』
も、
乗り越えられるかも……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Uergh... No, it's still much too soon for that...
Just saying the words makes me feel sick...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ、
どうやら私にはまだ早いみたいです……
言葉にしただけで気分が……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Not only am I feeling woozy, I'm seeing a strange light...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
気分が悪いどころか、
何か目の前に光が……！？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: U-urghh... What now? What now...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うう……
どうしよう、
どうしよう……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I came all the way here, but I don't think I can...
text_block_list.orig_text:
思い切って来てみたけど、
やっぱり私には……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Waaaaghh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃああっ！？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Oh... It's you, {0}...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
{0}さん、
でしたか……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what a coincidence.
I wasn't expecting a BB Brigade meetup here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐ、
偶然ですね……
こんな場所で、
ＢＢ団が揃うなんて……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Ummm, I came here for this high school's open house...
choice_data_list: In your first year of middle school? Impressive!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっと、
私は今日、
高校の見学会に来ていて……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
It's not impressive at all!
I mean, I didn't even make it through the school gate...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごくなんてありません！
現に私、
校門すらくぐれなくて……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
I just thought this was a good chance
to scope out the social challenges in my future...
text_block_list.orig_text:
先々のぼっちリスクを知るために、
いいチャンスだと思ったんですけど……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You'll show me around?
Ah! Th-that's my hand—!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
案内してくれる？
あっ、
手、
手を……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I-I came all the way inside...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
入っちゃいました……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
S-so this is your classroom...
Urgh...! Such overwhelming vibes of cameraderie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
ここが{0}さんの教室……
うう、
陽の気がチクチクと刺さってきます……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Oh...?
Who's this girl?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
何その子ー？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Eeek?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひぃっ！？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text:
Friend of yours, {0}?
Aw, how cute! How old is she?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたの知り合い？
かわいいねー、
何歳？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Yeeargh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひえぇっ！？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: No need to get so jumpy, kid!
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなにビクビクしなくていいのにー

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Awah... Waaahhh...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あわ、
あわわ……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's with the watering can?
text_block_list.orig_text: その手のじょうろ何ー？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Th-this is... my w... w...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これは、
じょ、
じょっ……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Watery Wartleby Wallington Wharf!
text_block_list.orig_text: じょうろじょろじょろじょう太郎くんーーーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Female Students 1 & 2
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁっ、
はぁっ……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I think I panicked a little...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません、
取り乱してしまいました……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Being pelted with greetings from friendly people...
High school really is a scary place...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんな明るい方々が次々に声をかけてくるなんて、
やっぱり高校は怖いところです……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, {0}...
You're like my guardian angel...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん……
なんて頼もしい言葉でしょう……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! I couldn't leave you to handle these trials alone!
I-I have to do my best too...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな、
{0}さんだけを矢面に立たせるわけには！
わ、
私も頑張りますから……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I really can't thank you enough...
text_block_list.orig_text: 本当にありがとうございます……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
But... When I enter high school for real,
you won't be around to help me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど……
私が高校に入るころには、
{0}さんはもういないんですよね……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm starting to feel like it'll work out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
なんとかなる気がしてきました……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
If I'm at the same school where the BB Brigade's captain went,
maybe even I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ＢＢ団の団長である
{0}さんが通っている学校でなら、
もしかしたら……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Even I... can say goodbye to my loner ways.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も、
ぼっちを抜け出せるかもしれません。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes!
There was a little thing bothering me,
so do you mind if I check it out?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！
少し気になる場所があったので
寄ってもいいですか？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
I spotted this flower bed while I was running away.
When I see flowers wilting, I just have to help them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃げてる途中に見かけて、
気になっていたんです。
元気のない花を見ると、
放っておけなくて……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Eheh.
Drink up, flowers, and grow big and strong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
たくさん飲んで、
元気になってね。

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Wha—?!Oh! You're holding a... watering can...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！　
あっ、
その手に持ってるのは、
じょうろ……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! It wasn't my place at all
to randomly give water to these flowers, was it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません！　
勝手に水をあげるなんて、
差し出がましい真似をしてしまいました！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, don't apologize!
It actually makes me happy to see someone else
who cares about the flowers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえいえ、
いいんです！
むしろ
花を気にしてくださる方がいて、
うれしいです！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: U-um, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, ehm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと、
その……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Th-the nerves are making me dizzy...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
緊張して目まいが……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: ...R-right...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ、
は、
はいっ……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Deep breaths, deep breaths...!
It'll be fine... {0} is watching over you...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
深呼吸、
深呼吸……！
大丈夫、
{0}さんも見守ってくれています！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: In... out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すぅ……
はぁ。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
U-um...!
D-do you... like flowers...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの……！
お、
お花、
好き、
なんですか……？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Aaaand welcome back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさま。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
That was a big moment of courage for Aoi,
so I hope you appreciated it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのアオイちゃんが踏み出した勇気の一歩、
ちゃんと見てあげた？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
At first I wasn't sure what to make of your BB Brigade,
but it looks like it's actually become a pretty big deal for her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ＢＢ団だなんて最初はどうなることかと思ったけど、
案外、
アオイちゃんにとって
大事なものになってるみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it really will be the support she needs
to say bye-bye to her bashfulness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この調子で、
本当にぼっちにバイバイできたらいいわね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'll see you later! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね～♪

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Mn... mnhhh...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
んん……？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! D-did I fall asleep in class?!
Huh?! The group lesson's already over?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ、
い、
居眠りしちゃってました！？
えっ、
グループ学習も終わっちゃってます！？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but that's terrible!
After I managed to join a group, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんてことでしょう……！
せっかく班に入れたのに……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You were just dreaming as well, {0}?
Ehh?! The same dream as me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
{0}さんも、
夢を見てたんですか……？
えっ、
しかも同じ夢を……！？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
That's the BB Brigade for you...
Even the world of dreams can't separate us...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがはＢＢ団、
見る夢までも共有されてしまうのですね……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 4
text_block_list.text: Aoi!
text_block_list.orig_text: アオイさん……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Eek! S-sorry! I'm awake now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ、
すみません、
起きてます……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Oh... You're... the girl from...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あなたは、
さっきの……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 4
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Aoi.
There's something I need to give you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アオイさん。
あなたに渡したいものがあるの……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
S-s-something for me?!
You mean... an Annulment of Friendship?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ、
渡したいもの！？
もしや、
絶縁状……！？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 4
text_block_list.text:
O-of course not!
Here, you can see for yourself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
違うよ……！
これ、
受け取ってください……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: This is... a card full of signatures...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ、
は……
寄せ書き……？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 4
text_block_list.text:
Your transfer period is ending pretty soon, right?
So the whole class made a goodbye card for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アオイさん、
もうすぐ
編入期間も終わりでしょう？
だから
みんなで書いたの。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: A-all this... for me...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こんな、
私……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 5
text_block_list.text:
Aoi! I didn't get to talk to you much,
but I liked having you around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アオイさん！　
あんまり話せなかったけど、
ずっと見てたよ！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Yeaargh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひゃっ！？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 6
text_block_list.text:
I always thought you seemed like a fun person!
We should talk properly sometime!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか面白い人だなって思ってたの！
今度はちゃんとお話ししたいな！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
A-aahh...!
Everyone in the class is gathering around...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひ、
ひえっ、
クラス中のみんなが、
私の周りに……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: So many people... all looking at me...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
人がいっぱい……
みんな私を見てる……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 4
text_block_list.text:
Aoi!
You're always welcome to come back and visit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アオイさん！
またいつでも、
遊びにいらしてください……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 4
text_block_list.text: Aoi...?
text_block_list.orig_text: アオイさん？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Too... too mu...
text_block_list.orig_text:
げ、
げっ……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Too munchable mulberry muchness!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 限界ギリギリ源五郎さんーーーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 5
text_block_list.text: Oh... my... She ran off at incredible speed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
まぁ……
走って行ってしまわれました。

text_block_list.name: Female Student 6
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Silly old Aoi.
She really is such a shy girl.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
アオイさんったら、
本当に恥ずかしがり屋さんなのね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
So Aoi fled the classroom as fast as her legs would carry her.
Her path to making friends was still fraught with hardships...
text_block_list.orig_text:
全力で教室から飛び出したアオイ。
友達作り活動は、まだまだ前途多難であった。
